WITH ev AS (

  FROM svc_pg.table_events GROUP BY party_id),

  SELECT ev.party_id, COUNT(b.staff_id) AS bussers_on FROM ev
  JOIN svc_fs.shifts b ON b.role = 'busser' AND DATE(b.business_date) = DATE(ev.business_date)
    AND ev.left_at >= b.start_time AND ev.left_at < b.end_time
  GROUP BY ev.party_id),
base AS (
  SELECT t.ticket_id, DATE(t.business_date) AS business_date, t.service, (CAST(strftime('%w', t.business_date) AS INTEGER) + 1) AS dow,
    s.section_id AS section, CAST(s.tables_assigned AS INTEGER) AS tables_per_server,
    (CAST(t.total AS REAL) - CAST(t.comp_total AS REAL)) AS revenue,
    CASE WHEN CAST(t.comp_total AS REAL) > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS comped,
    (CAST(strftime('%H', ev.seated_at) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(strftime('%M', ev.seated_at) AS INTEGER)) AS seated_tod, (CAST(strftime('%H', ev.left_at) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(strftime('%M', ev.left_at) AS INTEGER)) AS left_tod,
    (julianday(ev.greeted_at) - julianday(ev.seated_at)) * 1440.0 AS greet_min,
    (julianday(ev.delivered_at) - julianday(ev.ordered_at)) * 1440.0 AS order_to_delivery_min,
    (julianday(ev.bumped_at) - julianday(ev.fired_at)) * 1440.0 AS kitchen_min,
    (julianday(ev.reset_at) - julianday(ev.left_at)) * 1440.0 AS reset_min,
    COALESCE(bo.bussers_on, 0) AS bussers_on

  JOIN svc_fs.shifts s ON s.role = 'server' AND s.staff_id = t.server_id
    AND DATE(s.business_date) = DATE(t.business_date)
